title: shot-tracer ground truth
description: Hand-labelled ball positions for one fixture clip. See docs/TESTING.md for the labelling protocol and coordinate conventions.

file.description: Video file name, relative to this truth.json. Videos are gitignored and never committed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the video file, so a label set is tied to exactly one encode.

width.description: Display width in px, i.e. after applying the container's rotation metadata.

height.description: Display height in px, after rotation.

frameCount.description: Number of decoded frames in presentation order.

source.description: Free text: device, camera app, original file name, trimming command.

view.description: Camera position relative to the target line.

background.description: What the ball flies against for most of the labelled frames.

impactFrame.description: First frame on which the ball has left its resting position.

lostFrame.description: Last frame on which a human can still locate the ball. null if it never disappears within the clip.

frame.description: Frame of landing if it is inside the clip, else null.

landing.description: Where the ball came down, in the coordinates of `frame` (or of the last frame if frame is null). null if unknown.

points.description: Ball centre per frame, strictly increasing frame index. Frames between impactFrame and lostFrame that are absent are treated as unlabelled, not as 'ball absent'.

x.description: Display-oriented source pixels; origin is the top-left corner of the image, so the centre of the top-left pixel is (0.5, 0.5).

visibility.description: uncertain = labeller's best guess; excluded from error metrics.
